items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 25 at 1:07PM PST until November 26 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Tidal overflow flooding.

* WHERE...Central Coast of Oregon.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM PST Thursday during periods of high tide.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding, up to one foot above ground level,
during high tides is expected in the low lying areas near bays,
sloughs, and the lower reaches of the coastal rivers.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...For the Central Coast of Oregon, the total
tides at Newport (South Beach) will be 11.6 feet at 1 PM (Noon)
PST Thursday November 26.
items.instruction:
A Coastal Flood Advisory means that tidal overflow flooding is
expected. Coastal residents in the warned area should be alert
for rising water, and take appropriate action to protect life and
property.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 25 at 12:28PM PST until November 26 at 7:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph expected
for beaches and headlands.

* WHERE...Central Coast of Oregon.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 7 AM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds will blow down trees and power lines. Some
power outages are expected. Travel will be difficult for high
profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The period of strongest winds are expected to
occur between 3-7 AM PST Thursday. Although it will be windy for
inland coastal communities, maximum gusts will be relatively weaker
compared to beaches and headlands with gusts up to 50-55 mph.
items.instruction:
A High Wind Warning for the coastal headlands and beaches means a
hazardous high wind event is expected or occurring in those areas
along the immediate coast. Many of the headland areas and beaches are
vulnerable to very strong wind gusts that may pose a safety hazard
for individuals or high profile vehicles. The strong winds may also
cause property and/or tree damage. Sustained wind speeds of at least
40 mph or gusts of 58 mph or more are expected in those areas.
Coastal headlands are characterized by high, rocky shores and steep
sea cliffs.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Hazardous Seas Warning issued November 25 at 1:15PM PST until November 27 at 1:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Storm Warning, seas 16 to 21 ft at 16 seconds
and south winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 50 kt. For the
Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and hazardous seas 13 to 18
ft at 13 seconds and southwest winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up
to 35 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM and Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape
Foulweather OR out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Storm Warning, until 10 AM PST Thursday. Hazardous Seas
Warning, from 10 AM Thursday to 1 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Very strong winds will cause hazardous seas which
could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
A Storm Warning means winds of 48 to 63 knots are imminent or
occurring. Recreational boaters should remain in port, or take
shelter until winds and waves subside. Commercial vessels should
prepare for very strong winds and dangerous sea conditions, and
consider remaining in port or taking shelter in port until winds
and waves subside.
